decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records Heyzine selection, white-label use through the client's account, client account ownership, and client upload responsibility.
The client-managed Heyzine upload workflow does not change the required digital flipbook PDF deliverable, pages-format rule, or even-page requirement.
The candidate already records from the same message that the final PDF is the designated Heyzine upload artifact; upload responsibility does not alter that file-selection state.
The Heyzine upload-method decision does not change article-ending balance or filler-image rules; the separate image-only clause is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
Manual upload through the client's Heyzine account does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number basis.
The upload workflow does not alter the requirement for accurate final page references on the cover.
The client's ownership of the Heyzine upload step has no necessary effect on advertisement clarity or rendering quality.
The Heyzine account and upload-responsibility decision does not modify the selected body font or its readable treatment.
The manual Heyzine upload workflow does not change the issue month, edition, or other publication-date labeling.
The upload-method decision does not change the requirement to enhance publication images when necessary.
The Heyzine upload workflow has no effect on author-name, author-photo, source, matching, or placement requirements.
The client-managed Heyzine upload does not alter article category display, styling, placement, sources, or mappings.
